title: feat(pm): the half-state patrol reads the tier a triage round artefact names
body:
Fixes #18302

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈分诊座位职责〉 closes the triage seat's two-tier rule with a forcing function — 「选层按 fire 时刻,⛔ 不用计数器;简报写明本轮跑的层」 — and the filing card measured that nothing read the last clause (0 hits outside the two declaring files, with two lit controls on the patrol itself). The `domain:skills` seat ruled the direction ENFORCE.

## What this adds

One report-only H-row, `H65`, in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, plus 83 self-test cases. A triage round artefact that carries no `Tier:` line is a half-state: the two-tier rule is satisfied by silence.

- **Population** — the `pm:seat` post whose title begins `[PM seat] triage`. The execution seats have no two-tier rule, so they are out of scope by construction. ⛔ Deliberately not gated on `seatIsHeld`: that predicate excludes a `🟢 Routine` holder by name, and the triage seat runs as a Routine whenever no session has taken it over — inheriting H44's seat gate would silence this row exactly when the seat is on its schedule.
- **Shapes read, declared exactly** — the three measured on the seat post (`**Round-open marker** …`, `分诊轮收尾 …`, `# 🔻 收班简报 …`), judged on the comment's headline (its first non-empty line), plus H44's `R+N open` spelling reused **by reference**. H44 itself is untouched.
- **The one spelling** — a line beginning `Tier:` followed by `hourly` or `daily`, everything after the tier word free text. Another word, a decorated `**Tier:**`, a blockquoted `> Tier:` or a `Tier:` mid-paragraph are all findings: the spelling is closed on purpose (让正确形态成为唯一拼写).
- **What it does NOT judge** — whether the tier chosen was the right one. That selector is the seat's and is pinned in the runbook; this row refuses the silence, nothing else.
- Band `state` (H44's and H56's), five coverage counters on the enumerated forwarding contract, one summary clause.

## ⚠️ One measured deviation from the dispatched shape: the window

The dispatch said to read "whatever window the patrol already uses for seat-post comments". Measured before writing a line, that window cannot carry this row:

- `commentRowsFor` fetches `?per_page=100` with no `page`, and GitHub serves issue comments **oldest-first**. On the triage seat post (816 comments at the reading) that page is `2026-08-06T16:01:10Z` → `2026-08-10T17:29:28Z`.
- Both artefacts this card was filed about are from `2026-09-15` — five weeks outside it. The page holds ~81 August round-closes instead.
- A row on that window would fire forever on archive nobody will edit and never see a live round. That is a check that cannot observe its subject — the very shape this card exists to remove — so the seat's ruling (ENFORCE) is served by changing route, not by shipping it.

So the row **buys one page**: the newest, at page `ceil(comments / 100)` computed from the carrier's own count. One request per triage seat post per run (one such post on this board), no time constant to defend, no `since` window that can truncate the newest rows away. ⛔ The page is judged in place and **never written to `commentCache`**, so H44's, H56's and H64's corpus is unchanged — `prCommentCache` is the same refusal one row over. Residuals (an artefact older than that page; an unread page as UNJUDGED rather than clean) are declared in the row header and on every run in the summary clause.

## The one design choice the seat left open — and why no reference file is touched

Should the `Tier:` spelling also be pinned in the runbook's brief template? Four axes:

1. **实际业务需求** — measured: the brief's shape is defined in exactly one place, `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈分诊席读数成本三则〉 (four-section template, verbatim first-line marker). The H-row's remedy reaches the seat only *after* a violation, through the patrol anchor. Both channels are partial and neither substitutes for the other.
2. **项目长远合理性** — contract-first wants the producer's surface to carry the shape and the consumer to reject loudly. Remedy-only leaves the spelling known solely to the checker.
3. **防 AI 写错** — the writer is a fresh session per fire with no memory. A spelling absent from the authoring surface gets invented (`盘点层: 每日`, `Tier: 全量`), which is the (c)-shaped recurring remedy the skill ranks last.
4. **创业阶段不扩散** — one line in a template that already exists for this artefact; no new surface.

All four say add the line. **It is not added, because the ratchet has zero headroom**, and the dispatch says stop on breach:

```
check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md is 241 lines (ceiling 241; headroom 0).
check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is 812 lines (ceiling 812; headroom 0).
```

The only currency for a line is deleting content, and deleting a runbook rule is a protocol change outside this card. So: **no reference file is touched**, the remedy text is the spelling's only home for now, and the choice is the seat's to make — pay a line, or take the ceiling raise to the maintainer with a ruling.

## Reverse verification

**Predicate against the real artefacts** (bodies fetched through the REST proxy) — every one a half-state named, and every one clean once a tier line is added at line start:

```
5682407231  a round-open marker  -> absent   | + `Tier: daily (first fire of the day)` -> CLEAN
5681229485  a round-open marker  -> absent   | + tier line -> CLEAN
5659560733  a round close        -> absent   | + tier line -> CLEAN
5659616136  a stand-down brief   -> absent   | + tier line -> CLEAN
```

**Ablation**, from the committed state, both legs with on-disk and hash proof (blob `38864b3f` == HEAD blob before each leg; `git diff HEAD` empty after each):

| leg | on-disk proof | result |
|---|---|---|
| the tier-less branch returns `null` | `reason: 'absent'` occurrences 1 → 0, injected marker 1, blob `38864b3f` → `b044520b` | **19 cases red** (every fires/row case) |
| the closed tier set accepts any word | closed-set test occurrences 1 → 0, injected marker 1, blob `38864b3f` → `076713f3` | **4 cases red** (`Tier: full`, `Tier: 全量`, `Tier: Daily`, the echoed word) |

**Live patrol**, run the normal way (report-only, exit 0) against the live board:

```
H65 #6015 a round-open marker (comment `5682407231`) names NO tier at all — … 8 further artefact(s) in
this window carry the same defect; this is the NEWEST.

Triage round tiers (H65): 9 round artefact(s) judged on the NEWEST comment page of 1 of 1 triage seat
post(s) (16 comment(s) on those pages), 1 carrier(s) filed. …
```

All 9 artefacts in the live window are tier-less, `5681229485` and `5682407231` among them — one row per carrier naming the newest, which is H44's and H56's convention. They ARE the finding; no dated floor is applied (the file's only floor is H22's env-gated, default-unset `PM_SWEEP_CLOSED_FLOOR`, a per-install adaptation rather than an idiom for new rows).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 41 commands from the change set; all were run and reconciled with `--ran`. Self-test 4,113 → 4,196 cases (+83), ESLint clean on the file, `node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` green, control-byte scan empty.

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not filed — the seat decides:

- **H44 is blind on the same post, for the same reason.** Its header says the seat leg exists to reach the triage seat, "carrier of the round-open marker that is this card's worked example", but its corpus is the shared cache's first page, which on this 816-comment thread is five weeks stale — and `H44_ROUND_OPEN_MARKER` does not match the current marker spelling either (measured against all four bodies). H44 has therefore been reporting on August artefacts only. Not repaired here: widening H44 changes what an existing row reports, which this card forbids. Dedupe words: `H44 seat leg first page` · `commentRowsFor oldest-first` · `round-open marker spelling` · `untimestamped reading triage`.
- `direction=desc` / `sort=created` are silently ignored by the per-issue comments endpoint (measured); only `since` and `page` move that window. Recorded so the next author does not re-measure it.
